name: wayfinder-maps
description: A side drawer that shows every wayfinder map and spec in the project (markdown or GitHub issues), their tickets, statuses and dependency graph.

mapPrompt.title: Work-the-map prompt
mapPrompt.description: Prompt sent by 'Work next' on a map. {map} is the map path or issue URL.

mapTicketPrompt.title: Work-a-map-ticket prompt
mapTicketPrompt.description: Prompt sent by 'Work this ticket' on a wayfinder ticket. {map}, {ticket}, {title}.

specTicketPrompt.title: Work-a-spec-ticket prompt
specTicketPrompt.description: Prompt sent by 'Work this ticket' on an implementation (spec) ticket. {map}, {ticket}, {title}.
